```{r read}
res_cortex <- read.csv("cortical_result.csv")
res_subcort <- read.csv("subcort_result.csv")
library(ggseg)
library(ggplot2)
plot(dk)
```


```{r}
library(stringr)

res_cortex$roi <- res_cortex$roi %>%
  str_remove("^ctx_") %>%            # remove leading "ctx_"
  str_remove("_SUVR_infcblgm$")      # remove trailing "_SUVR_infcblgm"


```

```{R} 
# sanity check: see if there are any roi values that won't match
unmatched <- setdiff(res_cortex$roi, dk$data$label)
print(unmatched)

# map roi -> region using dk$data
res_cortex <- res_cortex %>%
  left_join(
    dk$data %>% select(label, region),
    by = c("roi" = "label")
  )


```


```{r}
cortex_slope_df <- res_cortex[c("region","slope")]
cortex_intercept_df <- res_cortex[c("region","intercept")]

```


```{r}
ggseg(.data = cortex_slope_df,position="stacked", colour = "black", mapping = aes(fill = slope)) +
  theme_void() +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "turbo") +
  labs(title = "Slope/Annual change in tau PET SUVR")
ggseg(.data = cortex_intercept_df,position="stacked",colour = "black", mapping = aes(fill = intercept)) +
  theme_void() +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "turbo") +
  #scale_fill_gradient(low = "goldenrod", high = "firebrick") +
  labs(title = "Intercept/Baseline tau PET SUVR")
```
